change: Include vendor-pool utilization in experiment outputs using already retained per-device telemetry. No change to workload, service processes, configuration or SMI sampling.
metrics: Time series of device-weighted mean utilization per pool
Measurement-stage sample mean and peak of pool mean
Explicit observed-only means for partial coverage
missing_semantics: Missing, stale and invalid samples are excluded and counted as uncovered. Whole-pool statistics are null when coverage is incomplete, never zero-filled.

validation.capacity_claim: None; this is metric-output acceptance, not completion of the running capacity/stability experiment.

limitation: Ascend .23 SMI timed out under the original frozen policy. Ascend covers only .24 devices 16/26 (61.54%); the observed mean is not the whole-pool utilization. Vendor SMI definitions may differ.
completion: For the already running original controller, a derived-result process exports now and refreshes once after the experiment and collectors finish. Future runs use the integrated final exporter. Processor identity is recorded separately from the original run revision.
maintenance: Extended the existing system_benchmark module and tests; no separate experiment implementation, environments or containers. Retained useful derived results and necessary evidence; no temporary code created.
